Players Committee card image of [[Daughter Of Skywalker (V) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “While at an Endor site, adds one [Light Side] icon here. During battle, may target one opponent's character present. Draw destiny. If destiny > ability, target is power -2 and its game text is canceled. Your scouts here are immune to Sniper, You Are Beaten, and attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/daughterofskywalker.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe a41bae9] (5 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
